# Definition colon

Short definitions keep the `:=` intact and spaced as one relation.

$$
  a := b
$$

A relation chain led by `:=` hangs its continuations under the assignment's
right-hand side, and never splits the colon from its `=`.

\[
  \hat{\mu}_{\textrm{MC}} := \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i = 1}^N h(X_i)
                             \rightarrow \mu
                             := \E(h(X_1))
                             = \int h(x) f(x) \ \mathrm{d}x
\]
